limitations: Not extended to nonabelian groups or three or more allowed sum levels.
No canonical equivariant splitting is claimed.
The connected generator-shift case is classical prior work, excluded from the new theorem.
Unindexed equivalent treatments of singular Latin bitrades may exist.

scientific_integrity.claim: Integral homotopy classification as a wedge of exactly d^2 orientable surface sheets and an explicit number of circles
scientific_integrity.correctness_basis: Coset-indexed surface normalization, connected sheet-vertex incidence graph, graph-of-spaces homotopy splitting
scientific_integrity.domain: Three-color two-level sums over finite abelian groups for which the shift generates a proper subgroup

title: Arithmetic normalization of two-layer abelian Latin complexes
